newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Labroy Marine placement share fully taken up.
newsitem.headline: Labroy Marine placement share fully taken up.

text.p: Singapore's marine-based Labroy Marine Ltd said on Thursday its 10.4 million placement shares in its initial public offer in Singapore were fully taken up.
"We are pleased with the positive reponse to our placement tranche demonstrating the institutions' confidence in our growth," said Tan Boy Tee, Labroy's executive chairman in a statement.
Labroy's share offer closes on October 16. Trading is expected to start on a "when issued" basis on October 18 subject to approval from the Stock Exchange.
